functional_requirements.FR01: User Authentication: The system must allow teachers/administrators to create accounts and securely log in.

functional_requirements.FR02: Student Management: The system must allow teachers/administrators to add, edit, and delete student records, including student ID, name, contact information, and class/group assignment.

functional_requirements.FR03: Attendance Recording: The system must allow teachers to record attendance for each student on a given date (Present, Absent, Late, Excused).

functional_requirements.FR04: Attendance Marking Interface: The system must provide a user-friendly interface (e.g., a grid or list) to easily mark attendance for multiple students simultaneously.

functional_requirements.FR05: Date Selection: The system must allow teachers to select a specific date to view or record attendance.

functional_requirements.FR06: Attendance Summary Reports: The system must generate reports summarizing student attendance data, including total days present, absent, late, and excused, for a specified period (e.g., week, month, semester, custom date range).

functional_requirements.FR07: Class/Group Management: The system must allow teachers/administrators to create, edit, and delete classes/groups.

functional_requirements.FR08: Attendance Export: The system must allow teachers/administrators to export attendance data in a common format (e.g., CSV, Excel) for further analysis or reporting.

functional_requirements.FR09: Search/Filter Functionality: The system must allow teachers to search for students by name or ID and filter attendance records by date, class, or attendance status.

functional_requirements.FR10: User Role Management: The system should allow for different user roles with varying levels of access (e.g., administrator, teacher).

functional_requirements.FR11: Multi-Device Support: The web application should be accessible and functional on different devices (desktops, tablets, smartphones) with responsive design.

functional_requirements.FR12: Data Backup and Restore: The system should provide a mechanism for backing up and restoring attendance data to prevent data loss.

non_functional_requirements.NFR01: Performance: The system must be responsive and load attendance records and reports within a reasonable timeframe (e.g., under 3 seconds).

non_functional_requirements.NFR02: Security: The system must protect student data from unauthorized access and ensure data privacy.

non_functional_requirements.NFR03: Usability: The system must be easy to use and navigate for teachers and administrators with varying levels of technical expertise.

non_functional_requirements.NFR04: Reliability: The system must be reliable and available with minimal downtime.

non_functional_requirements.NFR05: Scalability: The system should be scalable to accommodate a growing number of students and users without performance degradation.

non_functional_requirements.NFR06: Maintainability: The system should be designed in a modular and well-documented manner to facilitate maintenance and future enhancements.

non_functional_requirements.NFR07: Accessibility: The web application should adhere to accessibility guidelines (e.g., WCAG) to ensure usability for users with disabilities.

non_functional_requirements.NFR08: Data Integrity: The system must ensure the accuracy and consistency of attendance data.

non_functional_requirements.NFR09: Availability: The system should be available at least 99% of the time.

non_functional_requirements.NFR10: Security Compliance: The system must comply with relevant data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, FERPA, if applicable).
